strings.address_range: Address must be 0x%02X or 0x%02X (set by the ADDR pin)
strings.group.help: Diodes PI4IOE5V6408 8-bit I/O expander, 5 V tolerant, at 0x43/0x44
strings.init.help: Claim the part; every pin an input unless 'out' says otherwise
strings.interrupt.help: Show which pins have changed, and clear the flags
strings.interrupt_none: Nothing has changed since this was last read.
strings.interrupt_note: Reading this register clears it, so the next call reports only what changes from here.
strings.levels_not_register: These are pin levels, not the output register, so an output being held elsewhere reads as it is.
strings.levels_note: Levels were established before any pin became an output. A switch to ground with no external pull-up needs its bit in both 'pull' and 'pullup'.
strings.no_acknowledge: Nothing acknowledged at 0x%02X. 'i2c scan' lists what is actually on the bus.

not_initialized.text: PI4IOE5V6408 not initialized. Run 'i2c-pi4ioe init [address]' first.

strings.port_written: Port driven to 0x%02X; pins outside the output mask 0x%02X ignore it
strings.set_but_input: P%d set %s, but it is an input and will not drive. Re-run 'i2c-pi4ioe init' with an 'out' mask that sets bit %d.
strings.state_invalid: State must be 0/1, low/high, off/on or false/true
strings.unknown_option: Unknown option '%s'. Expected out, init, pull, pullup or int.
